subject: Tabby cat standing and looking toward the camera
set: Bright interior room with white paneled walls, a framed painting and a sandy floor, seen past a doorframe
notes: Cat is centred and framed by the blurred doorframe in the foreground, which gives a peeking-through feel. Its tail is raised.

subject: Man with arms crossed standing on a red glowing circle, with the 'Impostor' title above
set: Dark void-like background with a red glow, styled like an Among Us reveal
notes: Subject is centred and symmetrical. The red title at the top and the red glow at the feet frame him. Low-key lighting.

subject: Tan cat in the foreground, seen from behind, looking at a man and a white cat on a black car
set: Outdoor suburban lawn with a street, trees and a house
notes: Large foreground cat sits at left, with the background action small and off-centre. Depth layering, low camera near the grass.

subject: Man with a red bow on his head, looking down at the camera
set: Interior with a staircase, balustrade and ceiling tiles
notes: Camera looks up at him, so the ceiling is visible. The face is centred, the torso is large in the frame and the pose is slightly tilted.

subject: Framed photo of four cats on a pink paw-print background, one crossed out with an X
set: Wooden side table next to a vase
notes: Picture is centred-left, with the vase cropped at the right edge. Shallow table surface leads the eye.

subject: White cat with closed eyes being petted by a human hand
notes: Cat is centred against the green sofa. The human arm enters from the top left and the hand rests on the cat's head.

subject: Man sitting on the sofa reaching out, with a tabby cat in the lower right foreground
set: Living room with a staircase and a green sofa
notes: Cat is in the lower right corner looking at the camera, and the man is in the upper left. Diagonal composition with layered depth.

subject: Tabby cat standing on the sofa looking at the camera, next to a seated man's legs and hand
set: Living room with a green sofa, wall lamp and white paneled walls
notes: Cat's face is centred and in focus. The man is cropped at the torso and his hand points at the cat. Camera is at the cat's eye level.
